description: This file contains functions for encrypted file handling, cache management, and file system operations in a React Native project, specifically for the Notesnook app.

methods.name: readEncrypted
methods.description: Reads and decrypts an encrypted file from cache, returning the decrypted output.

methods.name: hashBase64
methods.description: Generates a hash of base64 data using Sodium.

methods.name: writeEncryptedBase64
methods.description: Encrypts base64 data and writes it to cache, returning encryption metadata.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified file from cache or via request options.

methods.name: clearFileStorage
methods.description: Clears all files from cache directories.

methods.name: createCacheDir
methods.description: Creates cache directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: migrateFilesFromCache
methods.description: Migrates files from old cache directory to new cache directory.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cache directory and emits cache cleared event.

methods.name: deleteCacheFileByPath
methods.description: Deletes a cache file by its path.

methods.name: deleteCacheFileByName
methods.description: Deletes a cache file by its filename, including app group path on iOS.

methods.name: deleteDCacheFiles
methods.description: Deletes specific cache files matching certain patterns.

methods.name: getCachePathForFile
methods.description: Returns the cache path for a file, checking app group path on iOS.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in cache or app group, verifying size consistency.

methods.name: bulkExists
methods.description: Checks existence of multiple files in cache and app group.

methods.name: getCacheSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of cache directory.
